body:
**Blocked by #171, #172, #173, #174, #175, #176** — the target group list excludes everything those slices move out.

### Change

Rewrite `src/config/settings-nav.ts` into six groups, grouped by subject/module to match the main sidebar (ADR-0004, ADR-0005):

```
ESTATE               Estate Info, Branding, Appearance, Streets,
                     House Types, Document Categories
FINANCIAL            Billing Settings, Late Fees, Invoice Generation,
                     Development Levies, Billing Profiles, Bank Accounts,
                     Transaction Tags
COMMUNICATIONS       Email Notifications, Message Templates,
                     Announcement Categories, Reminders, Reminder Schedule,
                     Notification Templates, Notification Schedules
ACCESS & SECURITY    Roles & Permissions (definitions only),
                     Security Settings, Contact Categories
INTEGRATIONS         WhatsApp, Gmail Import        (Paystack, SMS later)
MAINTENANCE & DATA   Maintenance, Data & Retention
```

~24 links, 6 groups, depth 2 — down from ~34.

**Merge `/settings/email-integration` and `/settings/email-integration/config`.** Both render an identical Gmail connection card; the base page is a near-total subset. Despite the nav describing it as "Email import rules", neither page configures a single rule. Take the config page's richer markup as the base.

Drop the now-unused `Activity` icon import if the System Health group disappears entirely.

### Do not miss

**Update the two group-name regexes in `e2e/enhancements.spec.ts` (TC4.9, TC4.10)** — they match `/billing.*finance/i` and `/estate configuration/i` and will silently stop matching once the groups are renamed. A silently passing selector is worse than a failing one.

### Docs

`website/docs/settings/settings-overview.md` (lists the old groups by name), `website/docs/settings/billing-and-notifications.md`, `website/docs/integrations/bank-feeds-and-email-import.md`.

### Verify

`npm test`; `npm run test:e2e -- enhancements.spec.ts`; `npm run build`.
